maya: Quick follow-up from the Vanguard postmortem. TL;DR: VPC peering transient + on-prem KV race caused tenant traffic to default-route. I split follow-ups and assigned owners. Link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/vanguard-2026
ops-bot: Follow-up ticket created: VGD-5501 (vanguard-remediate)  priority: P2
rick: I'll take the peering controller fix. Plan: make reconcile idempotent and add a route overlap guard. Target PR + staging by Wed. CHG-5012.
leila: I'll own the KV invalidation bug. Repro on onprem-sim at ~9k clients, failing in kv_store::apply_batch. Est 48-72h incl tests. PR when ready: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1350
owen: I'll handle customer comms and the mitigation (edge connection cap + short-circuit for affected tenant). Ticket: CUST-11677.
maya: Owners recap: peering -> @rick (CHG-5012/VGD-5501), kv bug -> @leila (VGD-5501/PR pending), comms -> @owen (CUST-11677). Please add exact dates/blockers by EOD.
rick: Noted. Customer can accept peering changes Mon/Fri 02:00-06:00 UTC; I'm aiming for Fri 03:00 UTC with rollback steps.
leila: Starting extended repro now. If green I'll open PR and schedule staging deploy for Tue.
owen: Draft notice prepared, will send after CHG slot confirmed. Also scheduling a post-change validation call.
maya: Adding alerts: "tenant_route_fallthrough" > 3/min and kv_apply_errors spike. I'll append to VGD-5501 and start a biweekly trends sync.
ops-bot: Linked issues: VGD-5501, CHG-5012, CUST-11677  https://tracker.redwood.com/VGD-5501
maya: Thanks team. Running first trends sync in two weeks; ping me for urgent updates. :white_check_mark:
